bento.heading: Why route everything through one gateway
bento.lead: One SDK, one key, one bill.

models.title: One key, every provider
models.desc: Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and more behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint, all on official upstream APIs. Switching models is a one-field change.

sla.title: Automatic failover
sla.desc: Several upstreams stay online at once. When one wobbles, traffic moves to a backup line and your app never notices — no retry logic to write.

proto.title: Drop-in OpenAI
proto.desc: Existing SDKs, IDE plugins and scripts keep working unchanged. Point the base URL here and leave every other parameter alone.

safe.title: Official keys, nothing retained
safe.desc: Every upstream is a paid official API. Requests are not inspected in the path, and neither request nor response bodies are written to storage.

steps.heading: Three steps to connect
steps.lead: From sign-up to your first request
steps.side: Already have a key? Skip to step three — the base URL is right on the home page.

key.title: Create an API key
key.desc: After signing up, issue one yourself under Tokens in the console. Revoke it any time.

base.title: Swap the base URL
base.desc: Point your client's base_url at this site's /v1 and leave every other parameter alone.

call.title: Send a request
call.desc: Your existing OpenAI SDK code works as-is — the first call already returns a result.
